item.description:

President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The Kyiv Independent reports Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli forces also raided Palestinian NGOs in the occupied West Bank and in Ramallah, targeting staff and offices. Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.

Iran’s foreign minister called the Saudi Crown Prince to urge diplomatic solutions as Iran-backed militants continue pressure on the Crown Prince.
